text: Make a realistic, silent 15-second widescreen story in three shots: a woman with a freckled face and red pixie cut drops a red scarf; a man with a shaved head and round glasses picks it up; he returns it and they smile. Both adults, on a quiet street. Show both faces clearly in every shot and keep exactly the same two faces throughout—no changing actors between cuts.
